mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS show positive growth, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a rising unemployment rate signals economic weakness that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5% and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust economic demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and GDPC1 show positive growth, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production growth regime (INDPRO > 1.0% monthly), a sustained increase in manufacturing output signals strong supply-side expansion that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO > 1.0% and INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals robust supply-side expansion that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has risen for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
